passages.quote:
The government is working to improve support for kinship families. This is part of the wider children’s social care reform. Being a kinship carer can present challenges to individuals remaining in work. They will benefit from extra support and flexibility from their employers.

This document provides guidance for employers on:

what kinship care is

what becoming a kinship carer means

available entitlements

adapting internal policies to include kinship carers

creating a culture of support

For more information, read the championing kinship care: national kinship care strategy.
